newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK manufacturing employment fell 13.5 pct in Dec.
newsitem.headline: HK manufacturing employment fell 13.5 pct in Dec.

text.p: Employment in Hong Kong's manufacturing sector fell 13.5 percent in December 1996 from a year earlier, the Census and Statistics Department said.
Employment in wholesale, retail, import and export trades, restaurants and hotels rose 3.7 percent during the same period.
In the finance, insurance, real estate and business services sector, employment was up 4.7 percent while employment on construction sites was up 19.2 percent.
Employment in transport, storage and communications rose 5.4 percent and in community, social and personal services was up 6.0 percent.
The number of vacancies on construction sites rose 92.6 percent.
